# Ellipsis Is Now SOC 2 Type I Certified


[@hbrooks · Hunter Brooks](https://github.com/hbrooks)


Ellipsis is now SOC 2 Type I certified.


If you'd like a copy of the report, contact us atteam@ellipsis.dev .


We maintain a strict no-data-persistence approach to handling your code: repositories are cloned into ephemeral sandboxes and discarded when the job completes. You can read more about how we handle security in our[security docs](https://www.ellipsis.dev/docs) .
